rationale: At revision 048fac696eda1fe7b9ee648ea8b202eb3338df55 src/analytics.ts:754, an unkeyed record claimed by a shared-turn slice and a complete window of another turn must remain unassigned with partial coverage, but rejecting the slice falls through to assign(resolved.phaseIndex, record, resolved.exact) and falsely reports complete coverage: using the existing shared-turn token fixture, omit the shared stop, retain prompts at 02s/12s across the R1/R2 boundary at 10s, and add another same-session turn prepared at 03s, prompted at 04s and stopped at 20s, which assigns the ambiguous 15s token to R1 and produces phase inputs [20,0] with a non-null total; preserve that cross-turn ambiguity through fallback and add this regression.
